# Turmoil, the radicals' share: half the color by 20%, the rest to all radical.
# Knots: 0 -> 0, 0.2 -> 0.5, 1 -> 1.
te_jmap_turmoil_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { turmoil < 0.2 }
		value = turmoil divide = 0.4
	}
	else = {
		value = turmoil subtract = 0.2 divide = 1.6 add = 0.5
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# GDP per capita, a year's GDP per person in pounds: a tenth of the color per doubling from 0.25 to 256 (a rich country about 1 in 1836, 8 in 1917, 60 today).
# Knots: 0.25 -> 0, 0.5 -> 0.1, 1 -> 0.2, 2 -> 0.3, 4 -> 0.4, 8 -> 0.5, 16 -> 0.6, 32 -> 0.7, 64 -> 0.8, 128 -> 0.9, 256 -> 1.
te_jmap_gdppc_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { gdp_per_capita < 0.5 }
		value = gdp_per_capita subtract = 0.25 divide = 2.5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { gdp_per_capita < 1 }
		value = gdp_per_capita subtract = 0.5 divide = 5 add = 0.1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { gdp_per_capita < 2 }
		value = gdp_per_capita subtract = 1 divide = 10 add = 0.2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { gdp_per_capita < 4 }
		value = gdp_per_capita subtract = 2 divide = 20 add = 0.3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { gdp_per_capita < 8 }
		value = gdp_per_capita subtract = 4 divide = 40 add = 0.4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { gdp_per_capita < 16 }
		value = gdp_per_capita subtract = 8 divide = 80 add = 0.5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { gdp_per_capita < 32 }
		value = gdp_per_capita subtract = 16 divide = 160 add = 0.6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { gdp_per_capita < 64 }
		value = gdp_per_capita subtract = 32 divide = 320 add = 0.7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { gdp_per_capita < 128 }
		value = gdp_per_capita subtract = 64 divide = 640 add = 0.8
	}
	else = {
		value = gdp_per_capita subtract = 128 divide = 1280 add = 0.9
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
